newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, light ends lose ground.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, light ends lose ground.

text.p: NWE oil products prices were mixed on Wednesday with light ends weaker while middle cuts and heavy fuels were steady to firmer, traders said.
Gasoline prices weakened in early trade after the API reported an unexpected build in U.S. gasoline inventories.
Eurograde barges traded down at $208 a tonne for ARA, some $2-3 under Tuesday's late levels after being offered aggressively lower by one Rotterdam refiner.
Naphtha was weaker with scarce buyers forcing sales at lower prices and with eastern arbitrage options closing as recent shipments from Europe start to pressure prices there.
Gas oil was unchanged with premiums holding steady in thin trade. Futures were a touch weaker, down between 50-75 cents.
High sulphur barges were pushed up from $85 to $89 by a single buyer bidding aggressively, but other fuel oil product markets were quiet and stable ahead of the Easter break.
